result_scope: binary64 result bits, exception flags, and per-call certification

oracle.name: GNU MPFR
oracle.method: mpfr_exp at 53-bit destination precision with the binary64 exponent range installed and mpfr_subnormalize applied; the reference is the correctly rounded value, not an approximation

limitations: Correct rounding is established per call by the certification test, not by a published hardest-to-round search over the whole domain; every case in this run certified, and an uncertified case would have failed the run rather than being delivered as proven
Ties-away-from-zero vectors are generated with MPFR_RNDN; exp(x) is never exactly halfway between two binary64 values for nonzero x, so the two nearest modes cannot disagree
The corpus is seeded and stratified, not exhaustive; no claim is made about arguments outside the generated distribution beyond what the certification test establishes per call
exp is the only function in this artifact; no other transcendental is implemented or claimed
